intents.intent: CLI entry point with commands for build, analyze, tasks, apply, query, explain, suggest, architect, compile, code-plan, repair-plan, arch-plan, arch-search, arch-simulate, api-link, viewer, drift, lock, and copilot-context.
Cross-language API endpoint linker. Detects backend HTTP endpoints and frontend API calls, creates workflow edges between them.
Extract HTTP endpoint definitions from Python source files. Detects FastAPI, Flask, and Django route decorators.
Extract HTTP API calls from JavaScript/TypeScript source files. Detects fetch() and axios patterns.
Scan project files for API endpoints and calls, match them by path patterns, and create cross-language workflow edges.
Data class representing a backend HTTP endpoint definition with path, method, handler node, and framework.
Data class representing a frontend HTTP API call with path, method, caller node, and library.
Result container for cross-language API linking with endpoints, calls, linked edges, and unlinked items.
